mechanism_narrative: A sustained positive trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained positive trend, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market weakness and economic contraction, generating negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises and housing starts (HOUST) fall, it indicates sectoral weakness in manufacturing and housing, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), central bank policy reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, yielding negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained positive trend in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals robust economic demand, generating positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained positive trend, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 index level indicates manufacturing contraction, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market expansion (PAYEMS) coincides with accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL), central bank tightening expectations drive negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST below 1600 and falling), economic overvaluation and impending slowdown cause negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
